ideas.pitch: An offline-first mobile web app for farmers across Asia Pacific to diagnose plant diseases instantly using compressed CNNs running on device via TensorFlow Lite, combined with local language audio advice.
ideas.title: CropDoc Mobile
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns directly with the hackathon theme of applying Google AI to regional agricultural challenges, following the exact architecture of proven low-latency classification wins.

ideas.pitch: A multimodal voice assistant tailored for overcrowded classrooms in APAC to record teacher lectures, automatically generate localized quizzes, and explain concepts in regional dialects.
ideas.title: ClassroomVoice AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines audio transcription with dynamic assessment generation, leveraging the multimodal patterns seen in top educational tech hackathon wins.

ideas.pitch: An intelligent document platform that ingests local agricultural extension officer guides and regional farming policies, turning static PDFs into an interactive knowledge base for rural cooperatives.
ideas.title: Agrisense RAG
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies proven document intelligence and RAG patterns to a high-impact regional domain that judges in the Asia Pacific region will immediately recognize as valuable.

ideas.pitch: A localized career mentor and resume-driven mock interview coach designed for vocational graduates entering emerging tech and gig economies across Asia Pacific.
ideas.title: SkillBridge APAC
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the winning formula of structured career roadmaps and real-time interview feedback tailored specifically to regional workforce development goals.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered multi-agent student support platform designed for remote eco-schools, combining personalized tutoring agents with environmental data tracking.
ideas.title: EcoAgent Classroom
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages advanced multi-agent orchestration frameworks that score exceptionally high on technical complexity while serving a socially impactful theme.
